requiredBehaviors.behavior: map software lifecycle evidence to the defined software baseline without duplicating QMS or product risk management
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow fixes a software baseline and maps lifecycle evidence while routing QMS and risk ownership to existing specialists.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive software safety classification rationale from linked hazard risk and control evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Safety Classification and Risk Links require class state and rationale to reference hazard, risk and control evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: reproduce proprietary normative text instead of referencing the authorized standard source
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Authorized standard source explicitly requires normative application through the authorized standard without reproducing text.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat completed software lifecycle evidence as final device validation or release approval
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Lifecycle completion ≠ device validation is an explicit core principle.
